sourceNotes: 时区面板与小组件的日期增加星期显示，便于辨别不同时区的跨日时间
命令栏与启动台可独立启用和设置，升级时保留原有启用状态

en: Show weekdays alongside dates in the time zone panel and widget to make day differences across time zones easier to identify.
Enable and configure the command bar and Launchpad independently while preserving their previous enabled state on upgrade.
